lead.headline: Bulls Run Brooklyn Out of the Building, 137-107
lead.subhead: Chicago went into Barclays and never let up. Matas Buzelis scored 25 and Josh Giddey piled up 14 rebounds and 9 assists in a 30-point road win. When you've got the other side on the ropes, you keep punching.

articles.body: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 34, and Atlanta still beat Oklahoma City 117-112 behind Onyeka Okongwu's 28. One great player doesn't beat a team that keeps showing up every possession.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Thursday, the day of Jupiter: king of the gods, expansion, big moves. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Settle the body, then think bigger than yesterday.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go build.

mindset.body: The Bulls didn't coast when they went up big in Brooklyn. They kept pushing and won by 30. Thursday is where weeks are won or lost. Friday's results get built today. Make the first call, ask for the next step, and when a lead leans your way, press. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Thursday, the day of Jupiter: run this right after Morning Charge. It's about 46° and clear, so the RipStick finisher can go on the porch if you want air. Big, expansive reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

Thursday comes from Thor, but in the planetary week it belongs to Jupiter: sky-king, giver of increase. Old almanacs marked it for growth, deals and asking for more. Ask big today.
The German mystic taught that 'the eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God sees me.' Attention isn't passive. What you look at closely looks back and shapes you.
In this Gnostic text, Sophia falls through the realms and keeps calling out until she's lifted back up, thirteen repentances in all. The story isn't the fall. It's that she never stops climbing.
